brief: @buildthis.bisks.net a site that scans all the replies to all of a users posts that tries to identify the funniest thing theyve posted by counting the amount of lol, haha, omg, lmao, rofl, and similar exclamations in the replies. Like count doesnt matter
note: built laughtrack.bisks.net — enter a handle, it reads every reply to their recent posts and counts lol/haha/omg/lmao/rofl, then surfaces whichever post actually made people laugh. ranked by that, not likes.
